title: HELIOS manifest-to-schema map (config/schemas/manifests.json)
description: Each mapping names one repo-relative manifest and the config/schemas/*.schema.json file that validates it. Validated against itself by scripts/validation/validate_config_schemas.py so a malformed map fails the same gate it drives.

repoRelativeJsonPath.description: Forward slashes, no leading slash, no '..' or dot-prefixed segments, ends in .json.

consumer.description: Documentation only: the script, workflow, or binder that reads the manifest.
